_note: Per-floor config. Escalator positions were read off the sheets once, by eye.
Three attempts at detecting them automatically all failed: the glyphs share a
colour with the jewellery category fill and with fire-exit signs, and routing a
shopper through a fire stairwell is a real failure, so a fragile classifier was
not worth shipping. There are only a handful per floor, and they are labelled
Shafts are linked ACROSS floors by atrium name, not by pixel position: the
sheets are drawn in the same frame but are not a clean translation of one
another, so the same atrium sits ~110 px apart between levels.

On the second-floor sheet the north-east shaft is printed "ATRIUM 5", but it sits within 30 px of the "ATRIUM 9" shaft on the floor below and is plainly the same one. The sheets disagree with each other; linking is by name, so it is declared here as Atrium 9. This is exactly the kind of call config exists to make.
